title: we won our first game jam with 3 people and a 48 hour ai cutscene pipeline
author: PresentationSad5344
selftext:
3 of us, a 72 hour jam, theme "its not what it seems". we placed 1st out of 212 and im still processing it.

the game: a lighthouse keeper sorting letters that slowly reveal the town drowned years ago. 15 minutes long. the cutscenes are what the judges kept mentioning.

the pipeline:

\- day 1: script and 9 cutscene beats, drafted with chatgpt and rewritten by hand (the draft was very "and then the darkness whispered")

\- day 1 night: key frames, painted over ai drafts so they matched our pixel art

\- day 2: key frames into 4 second motion clips on dreamina. like one buck for the whole jam, but it kept adding extra people to an empty town, which for a ghost story is kind of a feature

\- day 2 night: pixelated the clips with a shader so they matched the game. this is the trick. raw ai video next to pixel art looks awful, filtered it looks intentional

\- day 3: unity, timeline, audio, polish, panic

judges feedback: "the cutscenes made it feel like a full game".

were turning it into a proper release now, with all ai use disclosed on the store page.

happy to answer anything about the pixel shader, it was the real hero 🕯️
